codex.label: Codex primary orchestrator
codex.note: Primary Codex session; may independently review worker evidence but does not bypass human publication approval.

luna.label: Luna
luna.note: Worker profile only. Bind this to a verified provider model before dispatch.

phases.title: Unified coding-agent contract
phases.goal: Make every enabled framework produce the same safe proposal, execution and telemetry contract.
exitCriteria: All enabled engines pass contract tests
No engine mutates the workspace without approval
Failures are explicit and never simulated

tasks.title: Audit harness and comparison UX gaps
tasks.objective: Inventory the current eight-engine behavior, UI states and evidence gaps without changing runtime contracts.
deliverables: Contract input for P1-T1 and P1-T4
acceptance: Every claim links to a current code path or live test

tasks.title: Freeze Agent Contract v2
tasks.objective: Define versioned schemas for messages, artifacts, execution batches, tool events, telemetry and errors.
acceptance: Contract supports multiple files and multiple bounded commands
Approval payload covers the complete mutation

tasks.title: Build shared tool adapter
tasks.objective: Expose filesystem, terminal, Git and read-only MCP through one normalized adapter without granting authorization to the model.
acceptance: Every mutation requires a payload-bound approval

tasks.title: Upgrade six external harnesses
tasks.objective: Replace read-only benchmark adapters with full proposal-producing coding-agent adapters.
acceptance: Each ready engine proposes a file and command
Approval applies and runs the proposal

tasks.title: Coding-agent comparison UI
tasks.objective: Show proposal, tool trace, tokens, latency, execution evidence and contract failures consistently for every engine.
acceptance: Approval and execution results remain visible

phases.title: Reliable multi-agent execution
phases.goal: Coordinate planner, implementer, tester and reviewer in isolated worktrees with durable recovery.
exitCriteria: Concurrent agents cannot overwrite one another

tasks.title: Task state machine and durable queue
tasks.objective: Persist task dependencies, leases, retries, cancellation, checkpoints and idempotency.
acceptance: Workspace and task isolation are enforced

tasks.title: Per-task worktree isolation
tasks.objective: Create a dedicated branch, Git worktree and bounded execution environment for every mutating task.
acceptance: Tasks cannot mutate another task worktree
Paths stay inside the selected repository

tasks.title: Role handoff and review workflow
tasks.objective: Implement planner-to-implementer-to-tester-to-reviewer handoffs with bounded context and independent review.
acceptance: Reviewer cannot silently alter submitted evidence

phases.title: MCP control center
phases.goal: Make MCP discovery and permissions observable, scoped and revocable.
exitCriteria: Operators can manage MCP servers from one UI
Tool access is least-privilege and audited

tasks.title: MCP registry and lifecycle
tasks.objective: Add server registration, health, connect, disconnect and capability discovery.

tasks.title: MCP permissions UI
tasks.objective: Expose per-workspace and per-agent allow/deny policy with risk labels and audit history.
acceptance: Write and external actions require approval

phases.title: Repository-scale context
phases.goal: Ground every agent in fresh, relevant and provenance-labelled repository context.
exitCriteria: Large repository questions retrieve relevant sources
Stale snapshots are rejected or refreshed

tasks.title: Repository index and retrieval
tasks.objective: Implement incremental symbol-aware indexing with hybrid retrieval and token budgeting.
acceptance: Generated files and secrets are excluded
Every chunk has file and snapshot provenance

phases.title: GitHub and automation lifecycle
phases.goal: Add account-aware GitHub integration and controlled background workflows.
exitCriteria: OAuth/App installation replaces shared PAT dependence
Automations are cancellable, scoped and audited

tasks.title: GitHub App and protected publication
tasks.objective: Implement installation-based authentication, repository selection, checks and protected merge gates.
acceptance: Protected branches cannot be pushed directly

tasks.title: Automations and reusable profiles
tasks.objective: Add queued prompts, schedules, hooks, commands and versioned agent/skill profiles.
acceptance: Each automation has an owner and scope
Runs can be cancelled and replayed safely

phases.title: Production packaging and operations
phases.goal: Ship reproducible images that another operator can configure, observe, upgrade and recover.
exitCriteria: No secret exists in image layers
Upgrade and restore are documented and tested

tasks.title: Production images and profiles
tasks.objective: Create versioned minimal, full and benchmark Compose profiles with pinned dependencies and SBOMs.

tasks.title: Operations, recovery and release gate
tasks.objective: Add metrics, traces, backups, migrations, restore drills, quotas and release evidence.
acceptance: Release claims link to live evidence

phases.title: Agentic harness inventory
phases.goal: Expose only true agentic loops as coding engines, add a Conductor-native baseline, and keep retrieval or vendor wrappers out of the primary picker.
exitCriteria: UI labels distinguish agentic, ask-only and retrieval engines
Native Conductor loop emits Contract v2 through the shared tool adapter
SWE harness cannot mutate the workspace without approval

tasks.title: Classify engine capabilities in API and portal
tasks.objective: Stop treating six one-shot wrappers as equivalent to OpenAI Agents and LangGraph. Publish capability class and tool-loop evidence so the picker and benchmark stay honest.
deliverables: Tests that hide or demote non-agentic engines from the primary coding selector
acceptance: Benchmark can still include comparison engines with explicit labels
No engine is marked ready for coding unless a tool loop or Contract v2 mutation path exists

tasks.title: Build Conductor Native agentic loop
tasks.objective: Add a framework-free engine that uses Tesseract, the shared companion tool adapter, and Contract v2 approval.
acceptance: Read tools may run during planning without write authorization
Writes, terminal and git require payload-bound approval

tasks.title: Upgrade PydanticAI and CrewAI to tool loops
tasks.objective: Replace one-shot provider wrappers with adapter-backed loops, or demote them if native tools cannot be bound.
deliverables: CrewAI role loop or explicit demotion
acceptance: PydanticAI records real companion or MCP tool events
CrewAI either uses distinct roles or is labelled ask-only

tasks.title: Add OpenHands SWE harness behind Contract v2
tasks.objective: Promote the existing OpenHands smoke into an isolated coding harness that proposes mutations instead of writing the workspace directly.
acceptance: OpenHands cannot mutate another task worktree
Live smoke proves a file proposal plus bounded command

tasks.title: Move retrieval and duplicate enterprise wrappers to benchmark
tasks.objective: Keep LlamaIndex/Haystack as retrieval, and Semantic Kernel/Microsoft Agent Framework as optional comparison engines, out of the default coding picker.
deliverables: Picker copy that names the limitation
acceptance: Default coding picker does not list retrieval engines as coding-ready
Benchmark still compares them with source labels
Minimal profile no longer requires all six wrappers to start the portal
